summary: The explicit 2026-10-16 user direction removes backwards-compatibility requirements for active programme source and consumer work. Current selected compositions may replace obsolete variants, layouts, serialized bytes, fixtures and test populations rather than retaining compatibility-only scaffolding for an unselected consumer. The scope does not request unrelated mass cleanup or rewrite. Resulting qualification preserves substantive security, identity, ownership, boundedness, custody and failure/Unknown assertions; removed or replaced tests are recorded honestly, without relabeling historical evidence. Historical source and test/failure evidence at immutable pins and every original-operation identity remain intact. UTEL-DASH15 qualifies one coherent selected current producer/consumer composition with exact public revision binding, coherent publication, immutable installed exporter and activation adoption; old /1–/3 consumer compatibility and compatibility-first sequencing are not gates. Normal exact-source review, required final qualification, resource admission, independent operational readback and publication/installed-adoption/credential/replay safeguards remain; the direction admits no managed/native cohort or uncertain original.
title: Active programme work qualifies one selected current composition
